description: Your #1 Experts for Custom Crafted Dental Night Guards At TeethNightGuard.com, we are specialists in the art of creating custom dental night guards. When we say "art," we mean it. After all, what else would you call our hand crafted custom made guards? A division of Sparkling White Smiles Dental Lab, TeethNightGuard.com is dedicated to one single goal ─ providing our customers with premium quality, custom-fitted dental night guards at the most affordable price possible. A goal we have been able to actualize for over 15 years. Our custom night guards reduce the discomfort and protect against the harmful effects caused by teeth grinding and clenching, also known as bruxism. Whether you suffer from occasional teeth grinding and clenching or show symptoms of TMJ, we are the right experts to look to for help. Custom-made Teeth Night Guards Done Right Our mission at TeethNightGuard.com is a rather straight forward one. To create top quality custom teeth night guards at an affordable price. We are dedicated to advancing the quality by using the highest quality FDA approved materials and advanced laboratory techniques. Every custom teeth night guard we offer is BPA, latex and phthalate free. Each teeth night guard is made by a highly skilled dental technician to ensure the quality of the guard and a perfect comfortable custom fit. With the experience of thousands of custom dental night guards made we have thousands of satisfied customers. Additionally, TeethNightGuard.com gives customers the option of selecting between several different custom teeth night guards, based on the severity of teeth grinding and or teeth clenching. Hand-made and crafted by our dental technicians our custom-fitted teeth guards are not just created to be functional, they are made to fit perfectly for those they have been crafted for.
name: Teeth Grinding Guards | Custom Teeth Night Guards
